The '''Graveyard''' was the name of the main hangar bay of [[Starlyte Station]]. The [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Scizzic]] operated a repair shop here. It got its name because Scizzic collected spare parts and abandoned [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] that littered the floor of the hangar bay making it look like some sort of ship graveyard.
